title: ballota acetabulosa
intro: Ballota acetabulosa, commonly known as Syrian pennyroyal, is a plant species belonging to the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Syrian pennyroyal include its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Ballota acetabulosa include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
